name: Mujigi Balloon (Damage Increase)
description:
This balloon, shaped like a Mujigi, increases damage for 30 minutes.

**Note**
Can be used simultaneously with damage increase and damage absorption balloons.
Cannot be used simultaneously with STR and INT increase balloons.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
